definitions.explanation: A Japanese cracker made from rice, typically hard and crispy, available in various flavors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{煎餅|せんべい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I like soy sauce flavored rice crackers.

examples.japanese: {煎餅|せんべい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦バリバリ→バリバリ：05720_baribari⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Munch on rice crackers with a crunchy sound.
examples.notes: バリバリ is the onomatopoeia for crunching hard food

examples.japanese: ⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{草加|そうか}{煎餅|せんべい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought Soka senbei as a souvenir.
examples.notes: 草加市 in Saitama is famous for senbei

examples.japanese: ⟦おばあちゃん→おばあちゃん：10968_obaachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}くと→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{煎餅|せんべい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Whenever I visit my grandmother's house, rice crackers are always served.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海苔|のり}→海苔：10391_nori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}いた→巻く：02418_maku⟧{煎餅|せんべい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}ばしさ→香ばしさ：noentry⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{海苔|のり}→海苔：10391_nori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風味|ふうみ}→風味：14622_fuumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わさって→合わさる：12004_awasaru⟧、⟦お{茶|ちゃ}うけ→お茶受け：20903_ochauke⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Rice crackers wrapped in seaweed combine the savory aroma of soy sauce with the flavor of nori, making them a perfect snack with tea.

notes:
A traditional Japanese snack. Main types:
- ⟦{焼|や}き{煎餅|せんべい}→焼き煎餅：noentry⟧ (baked rice crackers)
- ⟦{揚|あ}げ{煎餅|せんべい}→揚げ煎餅：noentry⟧ (fried rice crackers)
- ⟦ぬれ{煎餅|せんべい}→ぬれ煎餅：noentry⟧ (soft, moist crackers)

Common flavors:
- ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧ (soy sauce) - most traditional
- ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (salt)
- ⟦{海苔|のり}→海苔：10391_nori⟧ (seaweed)
- ⟦{七味|しちみ}→七味：20131_shichimi⟧ (seven-spice)
- ざらめ (coarse sugar)

Famous varieties:
- {草加|そうか}{煎餅|せんべい} (Saitama)
- {南部|なんぶ}{煎餅|せんべい} (Iwate)
- ⟦えびせんべい→えびせんべい：noentry⟧ (shrimp crackers)
